newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks open firmly on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: French stocks open firmly on Thursday.

text.p: French shares opened strongly and climbed in early trading, lifted by strong Wall Street performance on Wednesday and optimism on prospects the stability pact will be signed in Amsterdam next week.
The CAC-40 index of blue chip shares opened up 30.31, or 1.12 percent, at 2,726.50.
After the opening the market continued to rise, hitting a high for the day of 2,746.26 before dropping back to 2,740.36, up 1.64 percent at 0939 GMT.

Filippachi Medias share, suspended on Wednesday afternoon remained untraded. A Paris court rejected bourse regulator CMF's decision to waive a bid requirement by Lagardere for all of Filipacchi as part of a plan to combine its media activities with Filipacchi, Lagardere said.
